headline: Most Expensive Apartment in Serbia Sold for 2.6 Million Euros! Square Meter in Old Town Reaches 12,000 Euros: RGZ Publishes New Data
summary: The most expensive apartment in Serbia in the first half of 2026 sold in Belgrade's Stari grad municipality for €2.6 million. It also set the highest price sold per square metre at €12,000, according to the Republic Geodetic Authority.
why: Prime property prices are an indicator of real estate market conditions and investor demand in emerging European markets.
